test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 1) Mid-Range Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: In a class of 60 students, 40% are girls. The average weight of the whole class is 59.2 and the average weight of the girls is 55 kg. What is the average weight of the boys?
solution:
**Given:**

Total number of students in the class = 60

Number of girls in the class = 40%

The average weight of the whole class = 59.2

The average weight of the girls = 55 kg

**Concept used:**

Average = sum of observations/Number of observations

**Calculation:**

Sum of weight of all class = (59.2 × 60) = 3552

Number of girls in the class = (60 × (40)/({100)}) = 24

Number of boys in the class = (60 - 24) = 36

Sum of weight of girls = (55 × 24) = 1320

Sum of weight of boys = (3552 - 1320) = 2232

Average weight of boys = ((2232)/({36)}) = **62 kg**

**∴ The average weight of the boys is 62 kg.**
